openalex_tjm2006.abstract: We give a necessary and sufficient condition for a set of triples to be a quotient of a (partial) latin square.

root_evidence.tjm_site: journal.taiwanmathsoc.org.tw redirects to a parked domain (ww16.*); not used
root_evidence.web_search: no lawful full-text copy; UASLP VIVO record is metadata only; Euclid route previously failed for reviewer (not retried)

root_decision: HOLD, zero credit. The 2006 Taiwanese J. Math. paper by the same authors states a necessary and sufficient condition for quotients of partial Latin squares, i.e. exactly the characterisation Conjecture 2 proposed; its body may contain, imply or routinely yield this counterexample. The 2005 Graphs Combin. version may have altered or dropped Conjecture 2. Both bodies are material same-object sources, consistent with earlier holds (330264, 335230).
reopen_if: Lawful readable TJM 2006 and G&C 2005 bodies show Conjecture 2 is neither resolved nor routinely refuted by their stated condition
